jobs.label: Très légère
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete original BASTION player armor sprite study for a futuristic cyberpunk roguelike. Genuine transparent background, no ground, shadow, weapons, text, symbols or extra objects. The supplied references are the SAME HUMAN MELEE CLASS in earlier appreciated armor studies: use them for identity, shared stance, camera, clean matte game-art treatment and restrained copper/slate palette. Not for tiny detail or facial implants. Mature robust brown-haired square-jawed human man with short beard. NO facial metal plate, NO glowing eye, NO recognizable franchise face, NO cyber-skull. Keep short neck, compact normal adult head, shoulders supporting it, no elongated throat. Whole figure from head to boot soles with margins, nearly front-facing in the same subtle elevated roguelike view as the reference, no dramatic perspective. Empty hands a little away from torso and visibly separate feet in a firm braced stance. Same approximate 58-pixel body height inside a 64 by 64 target cell. Preserve normal human stature: armor thickness changes the width, not a larger person or giant head. Upper-left lighting. Draw a sprite designed to survive 64px: broad calm value planes, two or three tones per material, clear dark gaps only at joints, no rows of bolts, scratches, tiny seams, decorative piping, stripes, speckles, dangling accessories or neon. Matte copper is desaturated reddish-brown metal with restrained broad pale highlights, not orange paint or gold. Slate-grey steel and dark textile support it. Only a few broad armor volumes carry the color; all secondary regions stay calm. Complete outfit includes head appearance, sleeves, gloves, trousers and footwear. Body and default head drawn coherently together.
STAGE 1 OF 5, VERY LIGHT. Redesign the reference into the starting, minimally protected outfit. Compact robust human anatomy, a narrow functional silhouette about 28 native pixels wide and 58 high. Short open slate-grey work vest over a dark charcoal reinforced shirt, broad plain fabric surfaces, forearms visible, modest plain dark work gloves. No metal chest cuirass, no shoulder armor, no hard elbow or knee plates, no hip plates, no thick greaves. Olive-grey trousers lightly reinforced by fabric only, slim plain charcoal ankle boots. One modest broad muted copper protective strip may sit at the upper vest opening, NOT scattered copper dots or buckles. Brown hair uncovered, entirely human unmasked face. The head is the default appearance of this whole outfit. Practical early-game melee clothing, clearly much lighter and less wide than the copper cuirass veteran reference. A believable tough brawler, not a thin other class. Keep the pose from the reference, and simple coherent dark cloth and olive masses.
